dataset: NRG demand forecasting and inventory-risk planning

grain.weekly_demand: one row per week, product, and market
grain.inventory_snapshots: one row per snapshot date, product, and holding location
grain.forecasts: one row per origin, target week, product, market, and model version
grain.planning_decisions: one row per approved replenishment decision

privacy: Synthetic business data with no real people or organisations
currency_policy: Monetary fields ending in _usd are nominal US dollars for the synthetic scenario
